# Ultravi0let

> A senior-only product studio in Cairo, remote-first, founded in 2022. We build and own the parts of software other people can’t see — and won’t touch: design, engineering, cloud and AI, from first prototype to production.

Contact: hello@ultravi0let.com

## Services
- Interface Design: UI and brand systems, visual identity, product surfaces and design tokens.
- Engineering: web and mobile applications written by senior engineers.
- Cloud & Infra: AWS and GCP architectures, CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code.
- Architecture: systems design for products that need to last.
- Security: threat modelling, code audits and compliance readiness.
- Integrations: payment rails, messaging, identity, AI providers and legacy systems.
- AI Engineering: production LLM pipelines with retrieval, evaluation and guardrails.
- Care & Support: monitoring, on-call rotation and ongoing partnership after launch.

## How we work
Four phases: Discovery, Architecture, Build (two-week sprints, a demo every Friday), Launch & Care.
